Thanks for seeding this. Quick read-through and a few suggested changes:
- Compress the validation window to 30 days but keep a 14-day hard checkpoint for perf/security gating.
- Add a security/compliance row in the MAP for SOC2 evidence collection + where to upload logs (we should use the private S3 bucket + customer access table).
- I added a lightweight RACI section:
  - R: EdgeHealth infra + Redwood runtime owners
  - A: Account exec (Jonas) for commercial acceptance; Technical owner (Marissa) for acceptance sign-off
  - C: Security/Legal (cc when SOC2 artifacts needed)
  - I: CS/Support

I’ve made inline comments in the doc (link above). Also flagging that if EdgeHealth plans to run PHI-like payloads we’ll need the on-prem/private deployment conversation earlier — note that in week0 checklist under "networking / compliance path".

If Marissa and I can align on milestone owners by EOD tomorrow we can send a single consolidated MAP to EdgeHealth before the kickoff.
